nom: Garnier SkinActive Micellar Cleansing Water and Makeup Remover with Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the product controls shine, mattifies, and leaves no greasy or sticky residue, with one calling it the best micellar water she has tried for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe themselves as dry or prone to dry skin are split: some find it non-drying and gentle enough for daily use, while others report it strips moisture and dries out their dry patches.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with hormonal acne, note it is effective but can feel drying, while another with combination, breakout-prone skin says the salicylic acid helps without harshness or tightness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no irritation, no reactions, and no scent issues, though one review separately mentions contact dermatitis reported by other users, especially around the eyes.
segments.mature: No reviews in this set specifically describe mature skin.

concerns.aging: No reviewer specifically links the product to aging skin concerns in this set.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it does not dry out their skin and leaves it feeling refreshed rather than tight, but others explicitly warn it strips moisture and recommend moisturizing after use to offset drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with skin prone to redness reports none appearing after removing makeup with this product; no other reviews mention redness.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer directly discusses barrier damage or repair; comments mostly concern dryness/stripping rather than barrier symptoms.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers credit the salicylic acid with minimizing the appearance of pores and helping treat acne/blemishes over time with consistent use, though one notes it does not clear acne overnight.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, or help with cystic breakouts and bacne; one reviewer reports the product did not work well for her skin overall.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report a mattifying effect and no oily or sticky residue after use.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin feeling refreshed not greasy
Cap or bottle can be messy

extraits.texte: I love most of this brands micellar water, so I was excited to try this. I'm not sure how i feel about it. I have combo, sensitive skin with hormonal acne issues. It's very drying. Especially if you're just using it as a prewash. I didn't notice s scent. My preteen likes to use it in place of a face wash. It's effective, it just drys out my dry spots a little much for me

I need Garnier to make a jumbo version ASAP!!!! This has single handedly helped with my cystic breakouts. I use it on a cotton round before my daily routine. But why stop there. I also put this in a bottle to apply to my itchy scalp. I also put this on my back for my bacne. I will put this on my body when it needs a gentle exfoliation. Its so lightweight & since it contains salicylic acid, it is such a multi use product!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this micellar water for a few weeks now, and honestly, it's become a staple in my skincare routine. As someone with combination skin that's prone to breakouts, the addition of salicylic acid in this formula is a game-changer. Pros: Effective Cleanser: It removes makeup and dirt effortlessly without the need to rub or rinse. Gentle on Skin: Despite containing salicylic acid, it doesn't feel harsh or drying—perfect for daily use. Soothing Formula: Leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean without any tightness. No Residue: Unlike some micellar waters, this one doesn't leave a sticky film afterward. Cons: Light Eye Makeup Only: It struggles a bit with waterproof mascara, so I still need a separate remover for that. Fragrance: It's minimal, but those sensitive to fragrance might want to do a patch test. Overall, this is a fantastic micellar water if you're looking to gently cleanse while also keeping breakouts at bay. It's affordable, accessible, and does exactly what it promises

I received a complementary sample of the Garnier Micellar Cleansing Water with Salicylic Acid from @influenster and @garnierusa in exchange for my honest review. The micellar water does a great job of removing makeup and leaving my face feeling refreshed and clean. I love the slight temporary tingle the product gives my skin. Feels refreshing! I have been using this product to try and help my acne prone skin recover from a breakout and I have noticed the difference! I will continue to use this product to see if my acne continues to improve!The packaging is minimal and aesthetic which makes it easy to read and understand. The product has no scent which is wonderful for sensitive skin!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This Micellar cleansing water with salicylic acid all-in-1 works great! After washing my face, I like to use this to get any excess build-up removed that regular washing doesn't remove. I feel like it really improves the overall cleanliness of your skin and helps to clear up your face. Just make sure to moisturize after using to prevent over drying your skin, since this definitely strips your skin of moisture while deep cleaning.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is one of the few products that takes off my waterproof mascara easily as well as cleanses the rest of my face. As someone with oily skin this works wonderfully as it doesn't leave any kind is sticky residue or oil behind. Even my husband has used it!

extraits.titre: Great Product for stubborn makeup, causes contact dermatitis
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great product it's so perfect for taking off that stubborn makeup, but I've seen other people that have been using this for a while saying it's caused them contact dermatitis - especially around the eyes. Yikes.
